section_7_intrinsic_mechanism.question: does the declared operator contain a spatial mechanism that holds the X population together?

operator_by_operator_analysis._diffuse: per species, per direction, Binomial(n, p_hop/4) with acceptance min(movers, dest_free). The only state dependence is the DESTINATION's free capacity, which BLOCKS entry into dense cells. That is an exclusion, i.e. a repulsion; it can only spread the population, never gather it. It reads no X-X interaction of any kind.
operator_by_operator_analysis._react: births of X occur where p_X = min(1, kX*nX*nY) > 0, i.e. only where nY > 0. With one organiser this is a SINGLE CELL. X is therefore created at a point source and nowhere else.
operator_by_operator_analysis._decay: Binomial(n_X, muX) per cell, position independent and neighbour independent. A molecule's survival does not depend on where it is or on what is next to it.
operator_by_operator_analysis._exchange: removes and reinserts only {SX, SY, WX, WY}; X is not in the exchangeable pool, so the operator does not transport X at all.
operator_by_operator_analysis.conclusion: no operator makes the transport, the birth or the death of an X molecule depend attractively on the local density of X. The only localising structure in the model is: births at one cell, plus a finite lifetime.

predicted_profile_if_that_is_all_there_i.form: the lattice Green's function of the death-modified walk, n_hat(k) = 1 / (1 - (1-mu) phi(k)), phi(k) = [1 - a(1-cos k_y)][1 - a(1-cos k_x)], a = 2q(1-q), q = p_hop/4

measurements.vs_N1_complete_spatial_randomness: observed quantile 0.000 for r50, r80, Rg and N_eff, and 1.000 for the main-mass and core fractions, in ALL SIX arms. The population is localised beyond any doubt.
measurements.vs_N4_label_permutation: identical: quantile 0.000 / 1.000 in all six arms.
measurements.vs_N3_static_point_source: observed quantile 0.73-1.00 for r50/r80/Rg, i.e. the observation is at or slightly ABOVE the no-interaction null: never more compact than it.
measurements.vs_N3b_wandering_point_source_with_the_r: observed quantile 0.33-0.82 for every observable in every arm. The observation sits inside the null, near its centre. This is the strongest available no-cohesion null: it uses the ACTUAL organiser trajectory and the ACTUAL recorded birth series, free diffusion, exponential lifetime, and NO interaction of any kind.

core_is_slaved_to_the_organiser.organiser_net_displacement_over_the_wind: 7.3 - 24.7 cells, matched by a core net displacement of 8.1 - 21.9 cells

measurements.core_motion_is_continuous_not_re-drawn: the mean displacement of the core centre over 10 steps is 0.23-0.29 cells, against 8.1-11.9 cells for the N5 decorrelated-frames null: a separation factor of 32 to 49. The core is a genuinely continuous object in space - but the thing it continuously tracks is the organiser.

section_7_intrinsic_mechanism.statement: the X population is localised, durable and traversed by turnover, and its localisation is entirely accounted for, with no free parameter, by a point source that wanders and a finite lifetime. Nothing in the declared operator holds it together; remove the organiser and there is no cohesion left to hold anything.

section_8_route.route_A_not_available: Route A would require a defendable localised core in the sense Question B needs, i.e. a cohesive object. Section 7 establishes ABSENT_IN_DECLARED_OPERATOR: the core is source-tethered, not cohesive.
section_8_route.route_C_required_as_a_prerequisite: every ORR01 spatial classification is contaminated by the defects D-4, D-5 and D-6, and the CSC01 gate is new. A mechanism cannot be compared against a baseline that does not exist under the gate that will judge it.
section_8_route.route_B_is_the_substantive_answer: Question B asks whether a minimal, physically interpretable, outcome-independent cohesion mechanism can produce a population that is compact, durable, traversed by turnover, not frozen, not wall-confined and not maintained by a success-reading controller.
section_8_route.design: one paired comparison on NEW seeds. Arm C0 is the unchanged balanced chemostat, which serves simultaneously as the Route C measurement of the inherited LawSpec under the corrected gate AND as the paired control of Route B. Arm C* is the selected cohesion mechanism. The C0 arms are explicitly NOT a confirmation of cohesion and are never reported as one.
